# SPEC 13.1: the 4-byte and 8-byte pairing above is upstream behavior.
# The same paired-load shapes built with this toolchain and with the
# pinned upstream go1.27.3 must produce identical result values under
# qemu-aarch64, so a pairing that changes meaning is caught even though
# the fused-shape checks still pass.
env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

[!exec:qemu-aarch64] skip 'qemu-aarch64 is required for the arm64 leg'
exists $UPROOT1273/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1273/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.3 '

env GOARCH=arm64
logos build -o $WORK/pair-logos$GOEXE .
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1273/bin/go build -o $WORK/pair-upstream$GOEXE .
env GOARCH=

exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/pair-logos$GOEXE
cp stdout $WORK/logos.txt
exec qemu-aarch64 $WORK/pair-upstream$GOEXE
cp stdout $WORK/upstream.txt
cmp $WORK/logos.txt $WORK/upstream.txt

-- go.mod --
module example.com/pairupstream

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import "fmt"

type pair64 struct{ A, B int64 }
type pair32 struct{ A, B int32 }
type skip64 struct{ A, B, C int64 }
type off504 struct {
	Pad [504]byte
	A, B int64
}
type off508 struct {
	Pad [508]byte
	A, B int32
}
type f64pair struct{ A, B float64 }
type f32pair struct{ A, B float32 }

func copy64(src, dst *pair64) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }
func zero64(dst *pair64)      { dst.A = 0; dst.B = 0 }
func load64(p *pair64) (int64, int64) { return p.A, p.B }
func swap64(p *pair64)        { p.A, p.B = p.B, p.A }
func loadSigned32(p *pair32) (int32, int32) { return p.A, p.B }
func copy32(src, dst *pair32) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }
func zero32(dst *pair32)      { dst.A = 0; dst.B = 0 }
func loadSkip(p *skip64) (int64, int64) { return p.A, p.C }
func load504(p *off504) (int64, int64) { return p.A, p.B }
func copy504(src, dst *off504) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }
func load508(p *off508) (int32, int32) { return p.A, p.B }
func copy508(src, dst *off508) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }
func copyf64(src, dst *f64pair) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }
func copyf32(src, dst *f32pair) { dst.A = src.A; dst.B = src.B }

func main() {
	a := &pair64{A: -9, B: 1 << 40}
	b := &pair64{}
	copy64(a, b)
	fmt.Println(load64(b))
	swap64(b)
	fmt.Println(load64(b))
	zero64(b)
	fmt.Println(load64(b))
	c := &pair32{A: -3, B: 7}
	d := &pair32{}
	copy32(c, d)
	fmt.Println(loadSigned32(d))
	zero32(d)
	fmt.Println(loadSigned32(d))
	s := &skip64{A: 1, B: 2, C: 3}
	fmt.Println(loadSkip(s))
	o := &off504{A: 11, B: 22}
	t := &off504{}
	copy504(o, t)
	fmt.Println(load504(t))
	fmt.Println(load504(o))
	w := &off508{A: -1, B: 5}
	u := &off508{}
	copy508(w, u)
	fmt.Println(load508(u))
	f := &f64pair{A: 1.5, B: -2.25}
	g := &f64pair{}
	copyf64(f, g)
	fmt.Println(g.A, g.B)
	h := &f32pair{A: 1.5, B: -2.25}
	i2 := &f32pair{}
	copyf32(h, i2)
	fmt.Println(i2.A, i2.B)
	fmt.Println("pair upstream ok")
}
